allowRemoval.description: Whether a proposal may ask for removal. Off by default; with it off an operation asking for removal is refused rather than downgraded.

debounceSeconds.description: How long a scope must stay quiet before a queued run becomes due.

maxRecords.description: How many records the scope may hold before every write is refused.
